resources.string: Your rules for reviews by %1$s, and the moves remembered from review cards.
How %1$s reviews a whole view or search: with /sweep, when you ask in the chat, and in routines. Every review ends in one card that you approve.
Write them in your own words. %1$s follows them in every review, and they come before the meaning of each move below. What you ask for in one review comes after them and wins where the two disagree.
Trash promotions and shipping notices once delivered. Archive only receipts, bank and tax mail, tickets and confirmations.
Worthless now: expired offers, notifications already acted on, mail that looks like spam.
No longer needs attention but could be useful to find later: receipts, confirmations, newsletters to keep. Only for mail in the Inbox.
Marked read and left where it is. Only for unread mail.
Left as it is: still useful, or it needs you.
The sender, subject and preview are not enough. The text of the email is read once; what is still unclear is left for you.
Always kept without asking: starred and important conversations, conversations you replied to, mail from people you write to, and invitations.
When you change a move on a review card, that move is remembered for the sender. In later reviews the sender\'s mail gets the same move without the model, and you can still change it on the card.
In later reviews, the model judges these senders\' mail again.
